parameters.content:
## How it works
This automation turns incoming support emails into structured FAQ entries.

It:
1. Monitors a Gmail support inbox.
2. Validates the incoming email payload.
3. Uses Google Gemini to classify the issue and generate an FAQ title, summary, answer, and recurrence flag.
4. Cleans the AI output into JSON.
5. Saves the FAQ entry to a Notion database.
6. Announces the new FAQ in Slack.
7. Separately analyzes urgency and customer sentiment.
8. Escalates high-priority issues to Slack.
9. Sends an acknowledgment email to the original sender.
10. Logs validation/parsing failures to Google Sheets.

## Setup after import
1. Assign your own Gmail OAuth2 credential to the Gmail Trigger and Gmail Send nodes.
2. Assign your own Google Gemini credential to both Gemini Chat Model nodes.
3. Assign your own Notion credential and replace the Notion database ID with your database.
4. Assign your own Slack credential and select your own channels.
5. Assign your own Google Sheets credential and replace the error-log spreadsheet ID.
6. Review the email fields, Slack channels, Notion properties, and polling interval.
7. Test the workflow manually before activating it.

Credentials are intentionally not included in this public template.

## Email Intake & Validation
Polls the Gmail inbox for new support messages.  
Ensures valid payload (ID, subject, body) before AI processing.  
Invalid or empty messages are routed to the Google Sheets error log.

## AI Analysis & FAQ Generation
Uses GPT-4o to read each email and generate structured FAQ data —  
including summary, category, short solution, and recurrence flag.  
The output is cleaned and converted to valid JSON for downstream use.

## Knowledge Storage & Team Notification
Saves the AI-generated FAQ entry to Notion and notifies your team on Slack.  
Each new FAQ includes title, category, and answer snippet with a Notion link.  
Helps your team stay aligned on new recurring issues.

## Urgency & Sentiment Detection
Analyzes the emotional tone and urgency of incoming emails.  
Flags critical or frustrated messages for instant Slack escalation.  
Ensures urgent support requests are handled in real time.
